directions.name: Tessera & Lime
directions.line: broken umber contours and hand-painted tessera joins
directions.shading: flat fresco planes with sparse tile shadows
directions.style_block: STYLE: A hand-drawn digital fusion of Roman fresco and mosaic. Broken umber contours surround flat chalk-lime and terracotta forms; small irregular painted tessera shapes cluster at architectural edges while open ground remains broad matte pigment. Mineral blue and pale turquoise carry water, vermilion carries hostile fire, dull ochre carries stone and bronze. Shading is flattened fresco colour planes with rubbed plaster gaps, never realistic volume; ornament has civic gravity but the mood is sun-bleached captivity. The mosaic is a drawing language inside the scene, not a photograph of a wall or a framed historical artifact.

directions.name: Salt & Scribe
directions.line: fine nervous pen with broken edges
directions.style_block: STYLE: Hand-drawn digital pen-and-ink on warm fibrous parchment, with fine nervous dark strokes, broken contours and dry-nib crosshatching. Mostly parchment and soot, with muted indigo washes for water, pinches of rust for hostile fire, and pale stone ochre. Shadows are sparse hatch groups and dilute ink pools; large untouched paper shapes keep routes and action legible. Narrow, wiry figures and economical architectural marks create a secretive, brittle, observant mood. No polished comic outlines or smooth rendered gradients.

directions.name: Hearth Under Guard
directions.line: soft brush edges with coloured pencil accents
directions.palette: butter yellow, dusty rose, sage, sky blue
directions.shading: opaque gouache layers and chalky dabs
directions.style_block: STYLE: Hand-drawn digital gouache storybook painting with opaque chalky brush layers, soft chipped edges and occasional coloured-pencil contours. Butter-yellow plaster, dusty rose roofs, sage cloth and sky-blue water make a warm muted palette; hostile fire uses coral orange, shadows use plum rather than black. Round compact silhouettes, broad overlapping colour masses and a few visible bristle dabs give readable medium-detail clusters. The mood is humane and quietly uneasy, warm lives enclosed by guards. Keep paint matte and hand-made, with no toy-like three-dimensional plastic rendering.

directions.name: The Vigil Cut
directions.line: heavy carved black outlines and gouge slashes
directions.palette: bone, lampblack, brick red, cold blue
directions.shading: dense angular hatch and negative cutouts
directions.density: high in shadows, sparse in paths
directions.style_block: STYLE: Hand-drawn digital woodcut comic, built from heavy carved lampblack outlines, angular gouge slashes and rough negative-space cuts on bone paper. Brick red and cold blue are the only broad colour overprints; warm grey grounds keep the black figures separate. Dense directional hatch accumulates in walls and shadow, while action lanes and camp routes remain broad empty cuts. Figures are sharp, squat and forceful; lighting is a graphic two-tone split. Defiant, severe prison propaganda energy, with deliberate print registration texture and no soft blended shading.

directions.name: Ash & Bronze
directions.palette: umber, charcoal, tarnished gold, glacial blue
directions.shading: scumbled dark paint with impasto highlights
directions.density: rich material texture with broad value grouping
directions.style_block: STYLE: A hand-painted digital oil illustration, dark and gritty, with lost-and-found brush edges instead of ink outlines. Scumbled umber and charcoal, tarnished bronze-gold and cold glacial blue sit on coarse canvas grain; hostile fire cuts through in a restrained ember orange. Broad dark value masses are interrupted by thick dry impasto highlights on cloth, sand and stone, never photographic detail. Rich texture stays grouped away from the action silhouettes and routes. The mood is oppressive, exhausted and solemn, with painted chiaroscuro rather than three-dimensional cinematic rendering.

directions.name: Forum in Four Inks
directions.line: bold clean shape edges, nearly no contour
directions.palette: warm cream, midnight navy, vermilion, cyan
directions.shading: flat spot-colour blocks and sparse halftone
directions.style_block: STYLE: Hand-drawn digital screen-print poster language made into a playable-looking overhead scene. Warm cream, midnight navy, vermilion and cyan form flat spot-colour blocks with near-absent outlines, simplified cut-paper geometry, slight ink registration and sparse coarse halftone only in large shadows. Monumental architecture is reduced to a few rectangles and arcs; figures have strong compact silhouettes with generous open ground. Water uses cyan and hostile fire vermilion. Mood is brisk, bold and unsentimental public spectacle. No gradients, realistic materials, dense texture or poster typography.

directions.name: Ember After Dark
directions.line: tapered luminous brush lines on black masses
directions.palette: aubergine, soot, electric turquoise, ember orange
directions.shading: hard cel shadows with concentrated painted glow
directions.style_block: STYLE: Hand-drawn digital dark-fantasy ink with tapered luminous brush contours over deep aubergine and soot masses. Electric turquoise water and ember-orange fire are small concentrated painted light sources; stone has muted mauve planes, and pale bone highlights reveal the silhouettes. Use hard cel-shadow shapes and spare scratch marks, with isolated brush-glow edges rather than broad bloom. Sparse islands of detail float against quiet darkness, giving a charged occult and rebellious mood. The camp remains magically suppressed, lit only by ordinary lamps and painted rim light. No neon signage, science fiction or three-dimensional rendering.

directions.name: Rain on Travertine
directions.palette: ivory, lavender, moss, ultramarine, diluted ochre
directions.shading: translucent wet washes with paper highlights
directions.density: airy open compositions with pooled detail
directions.style_block: STYLE: Hand-drawn digital watercolour on cold-pressed ivory paper, translucent wet-on-wet washes, pigment blooms and bleeding architectural edges. Very selective graphite marks anchor the small figures; lavender shade, moss cloth, diluted ochre stone and ultramarine water leave much paper white, with a small burnt-orange accent for hostile fire. Detail pools at silhouettes and landmarks while the ground dissolves into airy open washes. White-paper reserves keep effects and routes distinct. Mood is melancholy, fragile and contemplative; avoid opaque gouache, heavy outlines and smooth computer-rendered volume.
